passage:
Wed, 11 pm
Did something today I keep thinking about.
Rukmini got picked as science fair lead instead of me. Instead of telling her I was hurt, I went to Farhan and Joel at lunch and said she only got it because she flatters Sir. Then I told Anita that Rukmini laughed at her project idea. (She didn't. Not really.)
By last period, Farhan and Anita weren't talking to Rukmini. I felt good for about an hour. Like I had a team.
Then I saw her eating alone by the water tap, and the good feeling went sour.
Why didn't I just say it to her face? Because if I said "I'm jealous", she might laugh, and then I'd have nobody. Easier to make everyone else angry for me.
Tomorrow: tell Anita the truth about the project thing. Maybe say sorry to Rukmini. Maybe.
Lokesh

qa.q: What role did Rukmini get instead of Lokesh?
qa.a: Rukmini got picked as science fair lead.

qa.q: How did Lokesh feel after seeing Rukmini eating alone?
qa.a: The good feeling of having a team went sour, and Lokesh felt guilty seeing what the stories had done.

qa.q: What could Lokesh have done at the moment of being passed over?
qa.a: Lokesh could have told Rukmini directly about feeling disappointed instead of recruiting Farhan and Anita against her; tomorrow's plan to tell Anita the truth is a good start.

qa.q: What was the day like for Rukmini?
qa.a: She likely felt confused and isolated, suddenly shut out by Farhan and Anita without knowing why, and ended up eating alone by the tap.

grounding: A student, hurt at being passed over, complains to Farhan, Joel and Anita and twists a story to gain allies instead of speaking to Rukmini directly.

passage:
Damini: did u see Pia's story? she's at the mall with Tanya
Rukmini: oh. she told me she was studying
Damini: ya that's what she tells u. she told Tanya ur "too much" btw
Damini: just saying bc i'm ur real friend
Rukmini: wow ok. should i ask her?
Damini: noo dont say i told u. just see how she is tmrw
Rukmini: i feel sick now
Damini stared at the last line. Pia had actually said Rukmini was "too much fun to study with". Damini had been left out of the mall trip, and she hadn't wanted to say that out loud to anyone.
Damini: wait. i cut it short. she said u were too much fun to study with. i was annoyed they didnt ask me
Rukmini: why would u say it like that
Damini: i was jealous. sorry. i'll tell Pia myself that i felt left out

qa.q: What did Pia actually say about Rukmini?
qa.a: Pia said Rukmini was "too much fun to study with".

qa.q: What was Damini really feeling underneath the messages?
qa.a: Damini felt hurt and left out of the mall trip but didn't want to say it out loud, so she stirred up Rukmini instead.

qa.q: What was the turning point in the chat, and why did it matter?
qa.a: Seeing "i feel sick now" made Damini correct the twisted message and admit jealousy, and deciding to tell Pia directly replaces the go-between game with honest talk.

qa.q: How does Rukmini feel at the end of the chat?
qa.a: Rukmini is hurt and confused, first by the supposed insult and then by Damini's twist, which shakes Rukmini's trust in Damini.

grounding: A girl who feels left out carries a twisted message to stir jealousy between friends, then corrects it when she sees the hurt it causes.
